issue.title: upgrade coco to stable release line
issue.body:
## What changed
  - replaced the archived `coco-cashu-*` dependencies with the
  stable `@cashu/*` package line
  - updated imports, provider wiring, history types, and balance
  access to match the stable packages and hook shapes
  - migrated send, receive, mint, melt, and NFC payment flows from
  removed alpha helpers to `manager.ops.*` and
  `manager.paymentRequests.*`
  - updated the mint invoice flow to track stable mint operation
  events instead of the removed alpha quote event
  - added the missing `sendTokenErr` translation key across locales

  ## Why it changed
  The app was still pinned to the archived alpha Coco packages and
  APIs. The stable release line removes those package names and
  several compatibility wrappers, so this needed a real API
  migration rather than a package rename.

  ## User impact
  - the app now installs against the stable Coco package line
  - payment flows use the supported operation lifecycle for send,
  receive, mint, melt, and inband NFC payments
  - balance reads now align with the structured stable balance
  surface

  ## Root cause
  The codebase still depended on `coco-cashu-*`, including removed
  hooks like `useSend()` and `useReceive()`, removed quote access
  through `manager.quotes`, and removed payment-request wrappers on
  `manager.wallet`.
